Start at https://doctor.webmd.com/ and complete the following task by navigating within that website.

Find the best Audiologist within 50 miles of New York, NY, with a rating of 4 and above.

Rules:
- Work entirely in this one browser tab. Do NOT open new tabs.
- Do NOT use a search engine (Google, Bing, etc.) or cached/archived copies (e.g. web.archive.org). Navigate the site itself, starting from https://doctor.webmd.com/.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.
